title: Session Attendance, Course Start, Completion and Expiry — Tailwise Training
content:
# Tailwise Training: course rules for sessions

## 1. Attending a session

1.1 The enrollment status is enrolled or in progress when the session is attended. The status is the one shown on the company's record of that enrollment.

1.2 Each attended session uses one session from the enrollment.

1.3 A dog more than the course's late-arrival minutes late may watch, but the session still counts as attended.

1.4 Two sessions of one enrollment must be at least the course's spacing in days apart.

## 2. Course start, completion and graduation

2.1 The first used session starts the course, and the enrollment moves from enrolled to in progress. A session is used when it is attended or forfeited.

2.2 The last used session completes the course, and the enrollment moves from in progress to completed.

2.3 A graduation certificate is issued on completion where the course issues one.

## 3. Expiry

3.1 Sessions not used by the enrollment's expiry date lapse. The expiry date ends the validity period, counted in calendar days from enrollment, within which the sessions must be used.

3.2 When the validity passes with sessions unused, the enrollment, whether still enrolled or in progress, becomes expired and its remaining sessions are removed.

## Status at a glance

| Enrollment status | Session may be attended (1.1) |
|---|---|
| Enrolled | Yes |
| In progress | Yes |
| Completed | No |
| Withdrawn | No |
| Expired | No |

## Illustrations (hypothetical enrollments and figures)

**Lateness.** On a course whose late-arrival figure is 15 minutes, a dog arriving 20 minutes after the start may watch; the session counts as attended and one session is used.

**Spacing.** On an enrollment whose spacing is 7 days, a session on the 1st of a month allows the next session on the 8th or later; a session on the 7th would be 6 days apart and does not meet 1.4.

**Start and completion.** A 6-session group enrollment: the dog attends session 1, so the course starts and the status is in progress. The dog attends sessions 2 to 5 and the sixth is forfeited; the forfeited sixth session is the last used session, so the course is completed and, where the course issues one, a graduation certificate is issued.

**Expiry.** An enrollment with 2 sessions still unused on its expiry date: the 2 sessions lapse and the enrollment is expired.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a late dog lose the session?** The session counts as attended and uses one session, whether the dog trains or, being more than the late-arrival minutes late, only watches.

**Can a session be attended on a completed or withdrawn enrollment?** No; 1.1 requires the status to be enrolled or in progress.
